hints.title: Sequential State Decoupling
hints.text: Notice that the expression nums[i] - nums[j] + nums[k] depends only on prefix extrema as we iterate from left to right.

hints.title: Rolling Best Prefixes
hints.text: Maintain max_i (maximum nums[i] so far) and max_ij (maximum nums[i] - nums[j] so far).

hints.title: Single Pass Update
hints.text: At each incoming element x, update max_ijk using max_ij + x, then max_ij using max_i - x, then max_i using x.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass rolling dynamic programming variables.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Triple nested loop checking all (i, j, k) indices takes cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Chain prefix extrema sequentially in a single pass.
